take: Per the team's announcement, Minnesota reinstated center Nico Sturm from injured reserve and assigned center Hunter Haight to Iowa of the AHL. Sturm has played 8 games this season, averaging 10.53 minutes, with one assist and no goals. Minnesota has controlled 51% of the quality chances (expected goals) with him on the ice at five-on-five, though the team's share has been about 7 percentage points better when he is off it. The Wild come in at 9-3-2, so he returns to a team already winning.
